snippet.title: PC Longplay - Jurassic Park Trespasser HD [No Commentary]
snippet.description:
I did a playthrough of this game way back near the beginning of the channel, and I've always wanted to revisit it, and now in glorious (modded) HD!

This is one of those legendary bad games that has a special place in my heart because of how ambitious it was. Unfortunately, the development staff went over time and over budget, leading to the release of the unfinished, buggy mess we have today. That said, there are enough glimpses of almost-brilliance to make this game worth checking out. Hope you enjoy the playthrough!

If you're interested, I also have a commentated version with some additional information and discussion of the game, its history, and how you can play it today.
